factors.name: Elevation
factors.typical_source: DEM acquisition for Stage 2.5 feature stacks

factors.name: Regional magnetics (EMAG2 Stage 2.5 channel)
factors.scientific_notes: Distinct from client TMI catalogue sheets. Do not confuse with Abeokuta sheet-260 TMI processing products.

factors.name: Client / catalogue TMI (Abeokuta sheet 260)
factors.scientific_notes: Z is nT intensity, never elevation or overburden. Context + magnetic derivatives + candidate lineaments only.

factors.name: Lineament density
factors.typical_source: Uploaded vector lineaments or candidate magnetic lineament extraction
factors.scientific_notes: Candidates ≠ confirmed faults. Schema-v2 offline stacks may include density; live 13-ch assess does not inject it.

factors.name: Distance to lineaments
factors.scientific_notes: Metres in working CRS; unavailable when no vectors cover AOI.

factors.name: Overburden thickness
factors.scientific_notes: Never aliased from depth_to_bedrock or TMI Z. Abeokuta currently has no thickness inventory.

factors.name: Lithology
factors.scientific_notes: Not implemented as a catalogue layer in SSRI yet.

factors.name: Confirmed faults and fractures
factors.scientific_notes: Magnetic candidate lineaments must not be labelled as confirmed faults.

factors.name: Soil properties
factors.scientific_notes: Not implemented as a dedicated conditioning layer.

live_assess_rule: Live map assess uses the Stage 2.5 13-channel contract. Catalogue overlays remain used_in_inference=false unless a separately approved model integration exists.
